This BAA is interested in exploring new and advancing existing AI and distributed C2 concepts. By accelerating the research & development of novel AI-based and distributed capabilities to support Joint All Domain C2, the DAF can achieve a strategic decision advantage, where AI becomes a key and prevalent component to future C2 systems. With the rise of AI-based applications also comes new challenges to include the ability to effectively manage, monitor, and adapt deployed AI capabilities and effective C2 in a distributed and contested environment. Distributed operations is a critical component of Next-Generation C2. Key to the DAF transitioning from a single monolithic C2 node to multiple distributed C2 nodes is the ability orchestrate operational processes, while optimizing for limited resources. Through the development of distributed C2 capabilities the DAF can achieve an agile, fully mobile, distributed, and virtualized C2 operational capability. This BAA is interested in key areas for advancing C2 capability for the DAF to include but not limited to development and application of AI to C2, new concepts and techniques for the battle management and orchestration of AI at pace and scale, how the use of AI by adversaries can be considered in the C2 planning and execution process and distributed and collaborative C2 to enable C2 anywhere and anyplace. title: Netherlands, Germany – Industry specific software development services – Expertise for the Control Room of the Future program (Dynamic Purchasing System - EU-404)
description: Welcome to the Dynamic Purchasing System (DPS) for Expertise for the Control Room of the Future program and adjacent subjects. Note: This Dynamic Purchasing System is a continuation on the Mercell platform of the DPS that was previously operational on the Negometrix platform with Negometrix reference 159478 for which formal notice 2021/S 087-226573 was published on 5-May-2021 on the TED website. If your company was already qualified for participation on the Negometrix platform, a simplified procedure applies for re-establishing your qualification, see question 2.1 on the Mercell platform. TenneT will renew and innovate the (IT) systems that it uses for controlling and balancing its grids in the period 2021-2031. In connection with this, TenneT expects to be needing extensive external expertise, related to existing and new technologies and ways of working, in particular related to the challenges that TenneT faces in the energy transition. Compared to current ways of working, innovations will be needed to handle e.g. the increasing infeed of solar and wind energy that is far more difficult to predict and control than traditional generation. The subject of this tender procedure is a Dynamic Purchasing System (DPS) for expertise (including the development of algorithms and IT Tools) that TenneT needs in connection with the renewal of its (IT) systems related to the control and balancing of the electricity transmission grid. Initially, the DPS contains the following categories of expertise: 1. power system control and monitoring; 2. energy platforms and interconnected IT systems; 3. data analysis, artificial intelligence and machine learning; 4. system and process implementation. This Tender Dossier contains the rules for the Application by Economic operators for qualification under this DPS. In order to become qualified for one or more of the categories, the Economic operator has to fulfil all the requirements of this DPS. In addition, the Economic operator needs to the answer all Mercell questions, and submit the requested documents and-or evidence at the respective Mercell question with the submission of its Application. During the course of time, the specific assignments (contracts) under the DPS will be tendered for which all suppliers that have qualified for the particular category will be invited to submit an offer. Any interested supplier may at any moment during the lifetime of the DPS submit a request to be qualified for participating in the tender procedures for specific assignments within one or more of the categories of this DPS. Your request will be accepted if it satisfies the applicable requirements and if you accept the stated conditions. Once you have qualified, you will automatically receive a notification when TenneT publishes a request for proposal for a specific subject within a category for which you have qualified. TenneT emphasises that it would also like to attract small and medium sized companies to this DPS. Qualification requests will be processed by TenneT in the sequence of receipt. TenneT will inform you as soon as possible and endeavors to do so within 10 working days from the date of receipt about the acceptance or rejection of your qualification request. During the lifetime of the DPS, TenneT will be entitled to add new categories, to close existing categories, and to split-up existing categories in to one or more categories.

Solicitation No. 75H71326Q00076 is issued for continuation of the existing automated medical claims billing services used by the Indian Health Service (IHS), Portland Area, Western Oregon Service Unit (WOSU) and Warm Springs Service Unit (WSSU). Each purchase order will have separate funding, acceptance, invoicing, and payment records. The intended source currently provides the Assurance Plus medical claims billing service used by the supported facilities. Continued use for the one-year interim period avoids duplicate transition, account setup, payer-connection, testing, and training costs and reduces the risk of interruption to claims processing and reimbursement. USAG-HI is considering the potential privatization of the water utility systems serving Schofield Barracks � Main Post, Wheeler Army Airfield, Schofield Barracks � East Range, Pililaau Army Recreation Center, Fort Shafter, Tripler Army Medical Center, Fort DeRussy, Helemano Military Reservation, Kahuku Training Area, Aliamanu Military Reservation, and Makua Valley Training Area. The USAG-HI water utility systems to be privatized under this solicitation may include the housing portions of the water utility systems. Utilities Privatization (UP) is defined as the transfer of ownership and responsibility to a municipal, private, regional, district, or cooperative utility company or other entity, for the operations, maintenance, repair, future upgrades, and future utility systems replacements. The conveyance may consist of all right, title, and interest of the United States in the utility system. UP will be accomplished in accordance with 10 U.S.C. �2688 � Utility Systems: Conveyance Authority. As a result of this solicitation, the Contractor will be selected to assume ownership of the water utility system. The new owner shall operate and maintain the system and provide utility services to the Government. Any resulting contract, if awarded, will require the Contractor to furnish all facilities, labor, materials, tools, and equipment necessary to own, maintain, and operate the utility system. All responsibility for maintaining reliable service, including such items as environmental compliance, maintenance costs, major system renovations, construction, equipment, manpower, and overhead costs shall become the utility system owner�s responsibility. The Contractor shall manage the maintenance, repairs, replacement, etc., of the system to ensure continuous, adequate, and dependable service for each Government or tenant connection within the service area. The Contractor shall be responsible for funding all capital investments required to acquire, maintain, and operate the utility system in a safe, reliable condition and to meet the requirements listed in the contract. Real property interests will be conveyed in the form of a Right to Access or an Easement as a reference to the resultant contract. description: Réalisation et production de vidéos de qualité professionnelle, intégrant toutes les étapes de production, de la conception et rédaction du scénario à la post-production, en passant par le tournage. Ces vidéos seront diffusées sur tous supports digitaux (internet, réseaux sociaux, …) et sur écrans à l'occasion de manifestions publiques (salons, colloques, réunions…). La durée approximative des vidéos sera déterminée lors des réunions préalables avec le Service Communication de l'ISAE-SUPAERO. Deux missions sont à exclure : - La production audiovisuelle de supports pédagogiques innovants de type MOOC (vidéo pour formation en ligne certifiante) ; - Les prestations liées à la technique événementielle, intégrant les étapes de mise à disposition de régie audiovisuelle, de structure scénique, de personnels pour la réalisation et la production de manifestations événementielles (Cérémonie de remise de diplômes en présentiel ou distanciel, webinaires, colloques, etc.). Le détail des missions confiées au titulaire figure au cahier des charges. L'accord-cadre sera exécuté par l'émission de bons de commande lors de la survenance du besoin. Les prestations sont réglées par des prix unitaires

title: France – Advertising and marketing services – Prestations de communication numérique touristique et d'attractivité-.
description: Le présent marché a pour objet la structuration et la planification d’une communication numérique dédiée à la promotion des atouts touristiques de Troyes Champagne Métropole. Cette stratégie doit reposer principalement sur un vécu expérientiel dans lequel les prospects et repeaters (visiteurs récurrents) vont se projeter et s’identifier. Pour ce faire, les prestations attendues au titre de ce marché reposent sur une stratégie de promotion numérique sur Internet et les réseaux sociaux (dont ceux de l’Office du tourisme, de la ville de Troyes et de Troyes Champagne Métropole) et pouvant être déclinés en spots télévisés segmentés et replay. Conformément à l’article L2113-10 du Code de la commande publique, la présente consultation est allotie comme suit : Lot n°1 : Création et mise au format de visuels publicitaires ; Lot n°2 : Réalisation de vidéos et prise de photos ; Lot n°3 : Média planning et stratégie de diffusion numérique ; En application de l’article R2113-1 du Code de la commande publique, les opérateurs économiques peuvent soumissionner pour les 3 lots. Conformément aux dispositions des articles L2125-1.1°, R. 2162-1 à R. 2162-6 et R. 2162-13 à R. 2162-14 du Code de la Commande Publique, chaque lot donnera lieu, à la conclusion d’un accord-cadre mono-attributaire à bons de commande. Kyseessä on hankintalain 26 § 1 mom. 2-kohdassa säädetyn EU-kynnysarvon ylittävä tavarahankinta, joka toteutetaan julkisista hankinnoista ja käyttöoikeussopimuksista annetun lain (1397/2016) 32 §:n mukaisena avoimena menettelynä. Kyseessä on usean toimittajan puitejärjestely. Hankinta on jaettu suomenkielisen ja muunkielisen kirjallisuuden osa-alueisiin. Kuhunkin osa-alueeseen valitaan viisi (5) toimittajaa tarjousten vertailussa muodostuvan etusijajärjestyksen mukaisesti. Mikäli osa-alueella on vähemmän kuin viisi (5) soveltuvuusvaatimukset täyttävää tarjoajaa tai hyväksyttävää tarjousta, puitejärjestelyyn valitaan kaikki kyseisen osa-alueen soveltuvuusvaatimukset täyttäneet tarjoajat, jotka ovat jättäneet tarjouspyynnön mukaisen hyväksyttävän tarjouksen. . Kokonaistaloudellisen edullisuuden perusteet (arviointikriteerit) on esitetty tässä tarjouspyynnössä liitteessä Vertailukriteerit. Sopimuskaudella hankinta tapahtuu pääosin hankintaportaalin kautta; portaali vertailee kunkin yksittäisen hankinnan hintoja ja ohjaa tilauksen sille toimittajalle, joka tarjoaa sen edullisimpaan hintaan.

title: Provision of Audience Research Services
description: The Board of Trustees for the National Galleries of Scotland ("NGS") wish to award a Contract for the Provision of Audience Research Services. The Service Provider is required to conduct Audience Research to provide insight and analysis about our visitors in order to support the Organisation’s 2030 Strategy, Business Plan and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), special projects and inform organisation-wide strategic planning. The Service Provider shall be a member of, accredited by, or operate in accordance with the standards, codes of conduct and professional requirements of the Market Research Society (MRS) or an equivalent recognised professional body for market research, social research, insight or analytics. This Contract shall primarily provide Fieldwork Surveys and associated Project Management, Client Data Access, Analysis and Reporting for each of our four gallery sites. Services will be agreed to on an “as required” basis with no commitment to a minimum volume of work. NGS may, at its absolute discretion, require the Service Provider to provide Audience Research Services at this fifth site, currently under construction, at any time during the Contract term. If permitted by applicable procurement legislation, where additional audience research requirements arise during the Contract term that constitute an extension of the Services, NGS reserves the right to procure such additional services from the Service Provider. For full details of the Contract Requirements please refer to the associated Tender and Contract Documents. The Service Provider must have a clear understanding of the contract requirements and the organisational needs of NGS. As part of the tender exercise, the Service Provider must detail a robust and flexible methodology for conducting Audience Research Services that will meet all data capture requirements. There is no commitment to a minimum spend over the duration of the Contract. Under this Contract, no minimum spend is guaranteed. The agreement will be non-exclusive i.e. NGS reserves the right, in certain, circumstances, to procure out with the Contract Agreement, as and when required. In the event of unsatisfactory performance by the successful Service Provider and the termination of the contract by either party, NGS reserves the right to negotiate the continuance of the services with the second and third placed Service Providers.

description: Procedura de atribuire implică încheierea unui contract de prestare „Servicii de închiriere spaţii de depozitare și servicii conexe”, în conf cu prevederile Caietului de sarcini nr. 87263/05.08.2026. Clauză suspensivă: “Procedura de atribuire a contractului de achiziție publică având ca obiect servicii logistice de depozitare se derulează sub incidența prezentei clauze suspensive, în sensul că încheierea contr este condiționată de asigurarea și alocarea fondurilor bugetare aferente contrde finanțare pentru grantul”UCPM Logistical Hub for Ukraine UARO2-bis-UCPM hub”. În consecință, contr de achiziție publică nu va fi încheiat anterior îndeplinirii condiției suspensive, respectiv anterior asigurării fondurilor necesare pentru finanțarea serviciilor care fac obiectul achiziției. În cazul în care, indiferent de motive, în termen de 45 zile de la data aprobării raportului procedurii, nu este alocat bugetul aferent contr de finanțare a grantului ”UARO2-bis-UCPM hub” procedura de atribuire se va anula de drept, în conformitate cu prevederile art. 212 alin.(1) lit.c) teza 2 din Legea 98/2016, fiind imposibilă încheierea contr de achiziție publică. Ofertanții din cadrul acestei proceduri înțeleg că AC nu poate fi considerată răspunzătoare pentru vreun prejudiciu în cazul anulării procedurii de atribuire, indiferent de natura acestuia și indiferent dacă AC fost notificată asupra existenței unui asemenea prejudiciu. Ofertanții din cadrul acestei proceduri acceptă utilizarea condițiilor speciale de mai sus/clauzei suspensive, asumându-și întreaga răspundere în raport cu eventualele prejudicii pe care le-ar putea suferi în situația descrisă.” Clauză de revizuire: Procedura de atribuire a contractelor de achiziție publică este inițiată sub incidența clauzei de revizuire. În temeiul art. 221 alin. (1) litera a) din Legea nr. 98/2016, AC utilizează în cadrul prezentei procedurii de achiziție clauza de revizuire privind opțiunea de suplimentare a perioadei contractuale inițiale. title: Netherlands – Postal services – Postdienstverlening
description: Procedure Aanbesteding middels de Europees openbare procedure conform de (gewijzigde) aanbestedingswet 2012. Opdrachtgever De opdrachtgever bij deze aanbesteding is de Gemeente Breda. Voor meer informatie over de Gemeente Breda verwijzen wij u naar de website van de gemeente: www.breda.nl. Scope van de opdracht De opdracht omvat de integrale postdienstverlening voor de gemeente Breda, waaronder in ieder geval: het ophalen, sorteren, vervoeren en bezorgen van geadresseerde poststukken; het ophalen, sorteren, vervoeren en bezorgen van pakketten; het verwerken en bezorgen van verkiezingspost; het verwerken van retourzendingen; Haalservice (postbus)post en Brengservcie (postbus)post; het verzorgen van aangetekende poststukken (Binnenland en Buitenland) en overige bijzondere postdiensten; het verzorgen van kwaliteitsborging en prestatiemonitoring. De exacte omvang en inhoud van de dienstverlening zijn nader uitgewerkt in het Programma van Eisen en de SLA. Buiten de scope valt: verspreiding huis aan huis berichten (gemeentelijke berichten) en fietskoersdiensten. Percelen Deze opdracht is niet verdeeld in percelen. Doel Het afsluiten van een raamovereenkomst met één contractpartij voor het verzorgen van de postdienstverlening ten behoeve van gemeente Breda. Deze raamovereenkomst zal worden aangegaan voor een periode van 2 jaar. De ingangsdatum van deze raamovereenkomst is 1 februari 2027. De opdrachtgever heeft bij wederzijds goedvinden van partijen het recht deze raamovereenkomst tegen dezelfde voorwaarden en condities twee (2) maal te verlengen, telkens voor de duur van één (1) jaar. De maximale looptijd van de raamovereenkomst bedraagt derhalve vier (4) jaar. De besluitvorming ten aanzien van deze verlenging(en) geschiedt op basis van evaluatie van de geleverde prestaties van de dienstverlening. Gunning en motivatie De aanbestedende dienst gunt de opdracht aan de inschrijver op basis van het gunningscriterium laagste prijs, omdat de gevraagde dienstverlening volledig, objectief en eenduidig is gespecificeerd in het Programma van Eisen, de Service Level Agreement (SLA) en de raamovereenkomst. De vereiste kwaliteit van de dienstverlening is volledig vastgelegd in minimumeisen, prestatie-eisen, KPI's en contractvoorwaarden ten aanzien van onder meer bezorgkwaliteit, bestelkwaliteit, verkiezingspost, klachtenafhandeling, managementrapportages, continuïteit, traceerbaarheid, informatiebeveiliging en duurzaamheid. Alle inschrijvers dienen onvoorwaardelijk aan deze eisen te voldoen. De aanbestedende dienst is van oordeel dat inschrijvers zich hierdoor niet wezenlijk op kwaliteit kunnen onderscheiden zonder af te wijken van de gestelde eisen. Aanbestedende dienst is voornemens de opdracht te gunnen aan de inschrijver die een geldige inschrijving heeft ingediend en de laagste totale inschrijfprijs heeft aangeboden. Maximale contractwaarde De maximale opdrachtwaarde in het kader van deze overeenkomst wordt gesteld op € 2.000.000,- bezien over de looptijd van de overeenkomst, inclusief verlengingsopties. Aan het genoemde bedrag kunnen geen rechten worden ontleend. Voor opdrachtgever geldt geen afnameverplichting. Mocht gedurende de looptijd van de raamovereenkomst de maximale opdrachtwaarde worden overschreden dan zal de raamovereenkomst (eerder) worden beëindigd. Mercell Deze aanbesteding zal uitsluitend en geheel digitaal online worden afgehandeld via het Mercell platform (www.mercell.com). Een uitgebreide instructie met betrekking tot digitaal aanbesteden treft u aan in de Vragenlijsten.

title: Germany – IT services: consulting, software development, Internet and support – Bereitstellung, Customizing, Betrieb sowie Weiterentwicklung eines landesweiten touristischen Datenmanagementsystems
description: Die Ausschreibung umfasst folgende Arbeitspakete: Arbeitspaket 1: Feinkonzeption als Vorarbeit zur Umsetzung von Arbeitspaket 2 Dieses Arbeitspaket umfasst die nötigen Feinkonzeptionen für die Bereitstellung und vor allem das Customizing des Datenmanagementsystems. In der Feinkonzeption sind insbesondere folgende Punkte zu bearbeiten: - Gesamtarchitektur (Hard- und Software, Instanzen- und Mandantenmodell) - Datenmodellierung, -auszeichnung und -repräsentation - Rollen- und Rechtesystem, Benutzergruppen - Benutzeroberflächen / UI (Dateneingabe) - Qualitätsstandards und Doublettenprüfung bzw. -konsolidierung - Datensynchronisation zwischen Instanzen sowie Konnektoren beim Import aus externen Datenmanagementsystemen via API - Umsetzung der Complianceanforderungen (Barrierearmut, Datenschutz, Gesetze / Verordnungen (EU KI Act, EmpCo etc.) - Repräsentanz der Daten beim Export im Ausgabemanagement der Daten - Dashboards für das Systemmanagement und das Monitoring (KPIs) - initiale Datenmigration für den Import aus den bestehenden Dateninventaren Arbeitspaket 2: Customizing (Eingabe- und Ausgabemanagement), inkl. Datenmigration, Schulungen und Dokumentation Dieses Arbeitspaket umfasst im Kern die Bereitstellung und vor allem das Customizing des Datenmanagementsystems aufbauend auf Arbeitspaket 1. Dies umfasst die Umsetzung der Standardsettings (Datenmodell, Rollen / Rechte, Oberflächen, API-Management, etc.) und die Einrichtung von 12 Instanzen inkl. Datensynchronisation. Zur Einführung des Systems ist zudem eine Datenmigration aus den Altsystemen sowie zwei Legacy APIs (XML) zur Aufrechterhaltung der Datenflüsse für Schnittstellenkonsumenten zu den bisherigen Datensystemen umzusetzen. Das Arbeitspaket umfasst die Schulung für die TMB (Administratoren und Betreiber regionaler Instanzen), Schulungsunterlagen und eine Dokumentation. Arbeitspaket 3: Betrieb des API-Managements Die API-Infrastruktur soll im Rahmen des Projektes von der historisch gewachsenen Logik der XML-Exporte auf ein modernes API-Management umgestellt werden. Der Auftragnehmer übernimmt den laufenden technischen Betrieb des API-Managements des Datenmanagementsystems und stellt die zuverlässige, sichere und leistungsfähige Bereitstellung der APIs für die anzuschließenden Nutzer sicher. Arbeitspaket 4: Systembetrieb, Hosting, Support Der Auftragnehmer übernimmt den laufenden technischen Betrieb, das Hosting und den technischen Support des Datenmanagementsystems einschließlich der hierfür erforderlichen Systemkomponenten und stellt deren zuverlässige, sichere und leistungsfähige Verfügbarkeit während der Vertragslaufzeit sicher. Hierzu gehört insbesondere die Überwachung der Systemumgebung, Wartung und Aktualisierung der eingesetzten Komponenten sowie die Bearbeitung und Behebung von technischen Störungen. Für den laufenden Systembetrieb und das Hosting aller Komponenten werden die folgenden Leistungen gefordert, die entweder von dem Auftragnehmer direkt oder durch den Auftragnehmer zu beauftragende Dritte zu erbringen sind. In beiden Fällen ist der Auftragnehmer zentraler Ansprechpartner für den Auftraggeber und hat (ggf. gemeinsam mit seinen Subunternehmern bzw. die zu benennenden Dritten) die nachfolgenden Anforderungen sicherzustellen. Arbeitspaket 5: Konzeption und Aufbau / Integration einer Graph-RAG-fähigen Infrastruktur in das Datenmanagementsystem Graph-RAG-fähige Services sind dort notwendig, wo faktenbasierte, kontextsensitive Antworten aus kuratierten Inhalten mit KI-Systemen erzeugt werden sollen, etwa im Tourismusnetzwerk (als landesweites Informationssystem bspw. für Touristinformationen), in Serviceassistenten, Chatbots oder in internen Wissenssystemen. Um hier zukunftsfähig zu werden, wird dieses Arbeitspaket ausgeschrieben. Arbeitspaket 6: Betrieb einer Graph-RAG-fähigen Infrastruktur Der Auftragnehmer übernimmt den technischen Betrieb der für die TMB bereitgestellten Graph-RAG-fähigen Infrastruktur und stellt deren zuverlässige, sichere und leistungsfähige Nutzung während der Vertragslaufzeit sicher. Der Betrieb umfasst insb. die Verfügbarkeit der erforderlichen Komponenten für die semantische Suche und Bereitstellung von Wissen für die angeschlossenen Anwendungen. Arbeitspaket 7: Weiterentwicklung des Datenmanagementsystems und der angeschlossenen Komponenten Dieses Arbeitspaket dient der Kalkulation von Weiterentwicklungsaufträgen, die durch Einzelbeauftragung ausgelöst und umgesetzt werden. Arbeitspaket 8: Consulting für das API-Management Der Auftragnehmer soll die TMB bei der Beratung und Betreuung der rund 200 bestehenden und neu hinzukommenden Nutzer der APIs des Datenmanagementsystems unterstützen. Ziel ist es, die API-Nutzer bei der individuellen Nutzung, Konfiguration und Weiterentwicklung ihrer Datenanbindungen fachlich und technisch zu unterstützen und eine möglichst reibungslose Nutzung der bereitgestellten Datenströme sicherzustellen. Das Volumen des Auftrages beträgt geschätzt 332.500,00 Euro für einen Zeitraum von vier Jahren.

Deze uitvraag betreft de oplegging en inning/invordering van de door de gemeente uitgeschreven naheffingsaanslagen voor zowel Nederlandse als buitenlandse kentekens. Verder kan er bezwaar gemaakt worden tegen deze naheffingen. De afhandeling van deze bezwaarschriften en de afhandeling van eventuele daarop volgende beroepschriften vormen eveneens onderdeel van deze opdracht. Ter indicatie zijn hierbij de cijfers van 2024. title: Bereitstellung, Customizing, Betrieb sowie Weiterentwicklung eines landesweiten touristischen Datenmanagementsystems
description: Die Ausschreibung umfasst folgende Arbeitspakete: Arbeitspaket 1: Feinkonzeption als Vorarbeit zur Umsetzung von Arbeitspaket 2 Dieses Arbeitspaket umfasst die nötigen Feinkonzeptionen für die Bereitstellung und vor allem das Customizing des Datenmanagementsystems. In der Feinkonzeption sind insbesondere folgende Punkte zu bearbeiten: - Gesamtarchitektur (Hard- und Software, Instanzen- und Mandantenmodell) - Datenmodellierung, -auszeichnung und -repräsentation - Rollen- und Rechtesystem, Benutzergruppen - Benutzeroberflächen / UI (Dateneingabe) - Qualitätsstandards und Doublettenprüfung bzw. -konsolidierung - Datensynchronisation zwischen Instanzen sowie Konnektoren beim Import aus externen Datenmanagementsystemen via API - Umsetzung der Complianceanforderungen (Barrierearmut, Datenschutz, Gesetze / Verordnungen (EU KI Act, EmpCo etc.) - Repräsentanz der Daten beim Export im Ausgabemanagement der Daten - Dashboards für das Systemmanagement und das Monitoring (KPIs) - initiale Datenmigration für den Import aus den bestehenden Dateninventaren Arbeitspaket 2: Customizing (Eingabe- und Ausgabemanagement), inkl. Datenmigration, Schulungen und Dokumentation Dieses Arbeitspaket umfasst im Kern die Bereitstellung und vor allem das Customizing des Datenmanagementsystems aufbauend auf Arbeitspaket 1. Dies umfasst die Umsetzung der Standardsettings (Datenmodell, Rollen / Rechte, Oberflächen, API-Management, etc.) und die Einrichtung von 12 Instanzen inkl. Datensynchronisation. Zur Einführung des Systems ist zudem eine Datenmigration aus den Altsystemen sowie zwei Legacy APIs (XML) zur Aufrechterhaltung der Datenflüsse für Schnittstellenkonsumenten zu den bisherigen Datensystemen umzusetzen. Das Arbeitspaket umfasst die Schulung für die TMB (Administratoren und Betreiber regionaler Instanzen), Schulungsunterlagen und eine Dokumentation. Arbeitspaket 3: Betrieb des API-Managements Die API-Infrastruktur soll im Rahmen des Projektes von der historisch gewachsenen Logik der XML-Exporte auf ein modernes API-Management umgestellt werden. Der Auftragnehmer übernimmt den laufenden technischen Betrieb des API-Managements des Datenmanagementsystems und stellt die zuverlässige, sichere und leistungsfähige Bereitstellung der APIs für die anzuschließenden Nutzer sicher. Arbeitspaket 4: Systembetrieb, Hosting, Support Der Auftragnehmer übernimmt den laufenden technischen Betrieb, das Hosting und den technischen Support des Datenmanagementsystems einschließlich der hierfür erforderlichen Systemkomponenten und stellt deren zuverlässige, sichere und leistungsfähige Verfügbarkeit während der Vertragslaufzeit sicher. Hierzu gehört insbesondere die Überwachung der Systemumgebung, Wartung und Aktualisierung der eingesetzten Komponenten sowie die Bearbeitung und Behebung von technischen Störungen. Für den laufenden Systembetrieb und das Hosting aller Komponenten werden die folgenden Leistungen gefordert, die entweder von dem Auftragnehmer direkt oder durch den Auftragnehmer zu beauftragende Dritte zu erbringen sind. In beiden Fällen ist der Auftragnehmer zentraler Ansprechpartner für den Auftraggeber und hat (ggf. gemeinsam mit seinen Subunternehmern bzw. die zu benennenden Dritten) die nachfolgenden Anforderungen sicherzustellen. Arbeitspaket 5: Konzeption und Aufbau / Integration einer Graph-RAG-fähigen Infrastruktur in das Datenmanagementsystem Graph-RAG-fähige Services sind dort notwendig, wo faktenbasierte, kontextsensitive Antworten aus kuratierten Inhalten mit KI-Systemen erzeugt werden sollen, etwa im Tourismusnetzwerk (als landesweites Informationssystem bspw. für Touristinformationen), in Serviceassistenten, Chatbots oder in internen Wissenssystemen. Um hier zukunftsfähig zu werden, wird dieses Arbeitspaket ausgeschrieben. Arbeitspaket 6: Betrieb einer Graph-RAG-fähigen Infrastruktur Der Auftragnehmer übernimmt den technischen Betrieb der für die TMB bereitgestellten Graph-RAG-fähigen Infrastruktur und stellt deren zuverlässige, sichere und leistungsfähige Nutzung während der Vertragslaufzeit sicher. Der Betrieb umfasst insb. die Verfügbarkeit der erforderlichen Komponenten für die semantische Suche und Bereitstellung von Wissen für die angeschlossenen Anwendungen. Arbeitspaket 7: Weiterentwicklung des Datenmanagementsystems und der angeschlossenen Komponenten Dieses Arbeitspaket dient der Kalkulation von Weiterentwicklungsaufträgen, die durch Einzelbeauftragung ausgelöst und umgesetzt werden. Arbeitspaket 8: Consulting für das API-Management Der Auftragnehmer soll die TMB bei der Beratung und Betreuung der rund 200 bestehenden und neu hinzukommenden Nutzer der APIs des Datenmanagementsystems unterstützen. Ziel ist es, die API-Nutzer bei der individuellen Nutzung, Konfiguration und Weiterentwicklung ihrer Datenanbindungen fachlich und technisch zu unterstützen und eine möglichst reibungslose Nutzung der bereitgestellten Datenströme sicherzustellen. Das Volumen des Auftrages beträgt geschätzt 332.500,00 Euro für einen Zeitraum von vier Jahren.

description: The overall objective of this Call is the selection of Artificial Intelligence Gigafactory (AIGF) Consortia, which will establish and operate the AIGFs and from which the Contracting Parties will acquire AI compute access time. More in detail, the specific objectives of this Call are as follows: - Selection of AIGF Consortia: Following a rigorous evaluation of the tenders by the EuroHPC JU with the support of independent experts, the Governing Board will make an award decision, establishing a ranked list of successful AIGF Consortia. - Procurement of Compute Access Time: To establish a framework for the joint acquisition of a guaranteed share of AI compute access time from the selected AIGF Consortia, formalised through the signature of a Framework Contract and a number of subsequent Specific Contracts with the successful AIGF Consortia. De procedure verloopt volledig elektronisch via het online aanbestedingsplatform Negometrix. Een Dynamisch aankoopsysteem (DAS) is een elektronisch proces voor het doen van gangbare aankopen van werken, leveringen of diensten, waarvan de kenmerken wegens de algemene beschikbaarheid op de markt voldoen aan onze behoeften. Doelstelling DAS De doelstelling van het DAS is een zo groot mogelijke groep kwalitatief goede ondernemingen toe te laten zonder de beheersbaarheid te verliezen. Op deze manier creëert Defensie een optimale marktwerking, waarbij Defensie kwalitatief optimale Producten kan selecteren tegen zo laag mogelijke kosten, binnen de gewenste levertijden. Het MatlogCo beoogt hiermee op een eerlijke wijze, snel en eenvoudig haar behoeften op te vullen, door middel van volledige concurrentiestelling. Werking van het Dynamisch aankoopsysteem in het kort Voor deze aanbesteding volgt Defensie de Europese aanbestedingsprocedure 'Dynamisch aankoopsysteem', conform de Aanbestedingswet. Hierbij wordt onderscheid gemaakt naar twee fasen: 1. Instellingsfase 2. Gunningsfase Deze fasen worden nader uitgewerkt in vragenlijst 1.1. Kort samengevat Gegadigde dient een Verzoek tot toelating in; Als Gegadigde aan de gestelde eisen voldoet en er geen uitsluitingsgronden van toepassing zijn, wordt zij als Deelnemer toegelaten. Toelating tot het DAS houdt geen opdracht in; Het MatlogCo plaats een nadere uitvraag; Deelnemer schrijft in; Het MatlogCo beoordeelt de Inschrijvingen en gunt aan de economisch meest voordelige Inschrijving. Looptijd van het Dynamisch aankoopsysteem Bij de publicatie in maart 2023 had het Dynamisch Aankoopsysteem (DAS) een initiële looptijd van 48 maanden. Echter, aangezien deze DAS een voortzetting is van de vorige DAS met het negometrix nummer 210681, resteert er nu nog een looptijd van 35 maanden. Het is belangrijk op te merken dat de Aanbestedende Dienst de looptijd één keer kan verlengen, met een periode van 48 maanden. Het staat de Aanbestedende dienst vrij om aan het DAS gedurende de looptijd producten en/of kwalificaties toe te voegen of te verwijderen. Dit zal de Aanbestedende dienst waar nodig aankondigen met een rectificatie.

title: Netherlands – Supply services of personnel including temporary staff – DAS - Inhuur personeel - Koninklijke Marine (DAS-KM-3)
description: Omschrijving procedure Door middel van deze procedure stelt de Koninklijke Marine (KM) het Dynamisch aankoopsysteem (DAS-KM-3) in waarmee zij tijdelijke capaciteit en expertise gaat verwerven. Inhuur van personeel voor de betreffende categorieën zal in beginsel (behoudens lopende en nog af te sluiten raamovereenkomsten) via het DAS in de markt worden gezet. Hierop kan een uitzondering worden gemaakt indien het naar het oordeel van de KM noodzakelijk is om opdrachten op een andere manier te plaatsen. Bedrijfsprofiel De Directie Materiële Instandhouding (DMI), onderdeel van de KM, is verantwoordelijk voor het onderhoud aan en de bevoorrading van het materieel voor het Ministerie van Defensie. Voor meer informatie over het Ministerie van Defensie is de website www.defensie.nl te raadplegen. Doelstelling Dynamisch aankoopsysteem De KM beoogt met het DAS op een eenvoudige wijze, snel de behoefte aan kennis en capaciteit met goed en gekwalificeerd personeel op te vullen. Wij willen daarom een zo groot mogelijke groep kwalitatief goede ondernemingen toe laten. Op deze manier creëren wij optimale marktwerking, waarbij de wij uit een breed aanbod goed personeel kan selecteren voor de betreffende opdracht. Werking van het Dynamisch aankoopsysteem in het kort Gegadigde dient een Verzoek tot toelating in; Als Gegadigde aan de gestelde eisen voldoet en er geen uitsluitingsgronden van toepassing zijn, wordt zij als Deelnemer toegelaten. Toelating tot een categorie houdt geen opdracht in; De KM plaats een nadere uitvraag in een categorie; Deelnemer schrijft in met kandida(a)t(en); De KM beoordeelt de Inschrijvingen en gunt aan de economisch meest voordelige. Looptijd van het Dynamisch aankoopsysteem De looptijd is 48 maanden. De KM kan de looptijd met twee maal 48 maanden verlengen. Categorieën: De volgende categorieën zijn vooralsnog opgenomen: 1. Engineering Onder andere de volgende technische functies: Werktuigbouwkundige Electrotechnicus Scheepbouwkundige System Engineer Maintenance Engineer ILS-engineer Engineer E en WTB 2. Werkvoorbereiding & Planning Onder andere de volgende technische functies: Tekenaar/constructeur Werkvoorbereider Werkcoördinator Constructeur 3. Projectmanagement Onder andere de volgende technische functies: Projectmedewerker/ondersteuner/ Projectplanner Scheepscoördinator Projectmanager 4. Kwaliteitsmedewerkers Onder andere de volgende functies: Kwaliteitsengineer VKAM /KAM Toezichthouder Het staat de KM vrij om aan het DAS gedurende de looptijd functies en categorieën toe te voegen of te verwijderen. Dit zal de KM waar nodig aankondigen met een rectificatie.

title: 69--CH-53E Containerized Flight Training Device (CFTD) Baseline Configuration Upgrade (BCU) Pre-Solicitation Teleconference
description: NAWCTSD will host a Pre-solicitation Teleconference (mini-Industry Day) for the CH-53E Baseline Configuration Upgrade (BCU) focused exclusively on the Future Airborne Capability Environment (FACE) Technical Standard. This standard is referenced for the development of software as a part of solicitation N61340-17-R-0035. The pre-solicitation teleconference will take place on Thursday, 06 April 2017 from 1:00 - 3:00 pm EDT. The pre-solicitation teleconference will include a dedicated question and answer period allowing contractors to ask any questions related to the FACE portion of solicitation N61340-17-R-0035. Answers to the questions generated from this pre-solicitation teleconference will be provided to all potential offerors. However, it should be noted that, all questions to the stated solicitation, unrelated to FACE, shall continue to follow normal protocol, with contractors submitting a completed L-1 Question and Answer Form and emailing it to Nicole Knight at Nicole.knight@navy.mil. All interested TSC III Lot II vendors are welcome to call in to this teleconference and should request the dial-in number from NAWCTSD Contracts, Nicole Knight (nicole.knight@navy.mil) no later than 2:30 pm EDT on Wednesday, 05 April 2017. In this request, include your company name, attendees’ names, email addresses, phone numbers, and company address to confirm attendance. Subcontractor requests must be requested through the Prime Contractor. All attendees’ for each company are encouraged to use only one call-in line. The Future Airborne Capability Environment (FACE) Technical Standard is the open avionics standard for making military computing operations more robust, interoperable, portable and secure. The standard enables developers to create and deploy a wide catalog of applications for use across the entire spectrum of military aviation systems through a common operating environment, resulting in lower implementation costs, standards that support a robust architecture and enable quality software development, more capabilities reaching the warfighter faster, and innovation and competition within the avionics industry. FACE is maintained by The Open Group FACE Consortium, a government and industry partnership to define an open avionics environment for all military airborne platform types. The FACE Consortium is a vendor-neutral forum that provides standardized approaches for using open standards with avionics systems. The FACE Consortium works to develop and consolidate FACE open standards, best practices, guidance documents and business models. The Government has included a brief entitled “FACE 101�? for interested contractors to review prior to the teleconference. A NAVAIR Subject Matter Expert (SME) will present this briefing and attendees are encouraged to download the briefing so that they can follow along as he presents the materials. For more information regarding FACE, including the FACE Standards, FACE Data Architecture, The Open Group Architecture Framework Technical Reference Model, and related documentation, please visit the Open Group website at: http://www.opengroup.org/face. Failure of an offeror to call-in to the conference or to submit any questions will be construed to mean that the offeror fully understands all requirements of the solicitation. Prospective offerors are advised that the teleconference will be held solely for the purpose of explaining the FACE Technical Standard as it relates to this solicitation. All prospective offerors are advised that solicitation N61340-17-R-0035 will remain unchanged at the conclusion of the teleconference, unless this solicitation is amended in writing. If an amendment is issued, normal procedures relating to the acknowledgement and receipt of any such amendment shall be applicable. In no event, will failure to attend the conference constitute grounds for a claim after award of the delivery order. title: Doric Lenses FluoPulse Fiber Photometry / Fluorescence Lifetime Photometry System and Accessories
description: FAR 6.302-1 � Only One Responsible Source Solicitation Number 75N98026Q01219 Title Doric Lenses FluoPulse Fiber Photometry / Fluorescence Lifetime Photometry System and Accessories Description of Requirement The National Institutes of Health (NIH), National Institute on Alcohol Abuse and Alcoholism (NIAAA), SensMET, requires an integrated fiber photometry and fluorescence lifetime photometry system to support ongoing and planned intramural research experiments. The requirement will support neuroscience research experiments that require time-resolved, two-color photometry recordings, optogenetic stimulation capability, calibrated optical power measurement, synchronized behavioral video acquisition, and compatible data analysis software. The National Institutes of Health, National Institute on Alcohol Abuse and Alcoholism (NIAAA), intends to award a contract to Government Scientific Source, Inc. on a sole-source basis pursuant to FAR 6.302-1, Only One Responsible Source and No Other Supplies or Services Will Satisfy Agency Requirements, for the acquisition of a Doric Lenses FluoPulse Fiber Photometry / Fluorescence Lifetime Photometry System. Doric Lenses FluoPulse Fiber Photometry / Fluorescence Lifetime Photometry System and Accessories Pursuant to FAR 6.302-1, the Government intends to solicit and award a Purchase Order on a sole-source basis because the Government's minimum technical requirements will be satisfied by Government Scientific Source, Inc. Accordingly, the Government intends to award a sole-source contract to Government Scientific Source, Inc. pursuant to FAR 6.302-1. The requiring activity needs an integrated fluorescence lifetime photometry/fiber photometry platform for intramural neuroscience research experiments requiring two-color photometry recording, optogenetic stimulation capability, calibrated optical power measurement, synchronized behavior video acquisition, and compatible data analysis software. The requested Doric FluoPulse configuration includes a FluoPulse console; a seven-port fluorescence lifetime photometry recording mini cube with two integrated photodetectors, two integrated laser diode/excitation channels, an external 560 nm laser port, 500-540 nm and 580-600 nm detection paths, and 638 nm opto capability; a compatible fiberoptic rotary joint and low-autofluorescence fiber interfaces; a 638 nm, 80 mW laser diode fiber light source; a power meter package; a USB 3.0 behavior camera; a calibration sample; a Doric-configured high-performance workstation; and one-year danse data analysis software license. These components are requested as an integrated system because the optical hardware, fiber interfaces, calibration components, workstation, camera, and software must operate together as a validated experimental workflow. A substitute or piecemeal system would require redesign and revalidation of the optical path, fiber connections, calibration procedure, acquisition settings, and data analysis workflow, creating technical risk and potentially delaying or interrupting intramural research experiments. The requested supply/service therefore meets the Government's need for a complete, compatible, manufacturer-supported FluoPulse system configured for two-color + opto single-site experiments. Government Scientific Source Inc. is the quoted distributor/source for the Doric FluoPulse console, fluorescence lifetime photometry mini cube, Doric-compatible fiberoptic accessories, FluoPulse calibration sample, Doric-configured workstation, and danse data analysis software license. Government Scientific Source Inc. is positioned to provide the complete integrated package under one order, including manufacturer-compatible hardware, software, accessories, calibration components, shipping/handling, and DDP customs clearance. Because compatibility among the console, mini cube, fiberoptic components, laser/light source, power meter, camera, workstation, calibration sample, and analysis software is essential to successful experimental performance, a third-party or mixed-source solution would not provide the same manufacturer-supported configuration and would introduce unacceptable risk to system compatibility, setup, calibration, and technical support. title: France – Camping-site services – Délégation de service public pour l'exploitation du camping municipal de la commune de Saint-Sever
description: La présente consultation a pour objet la conclusion d'un contrat de délégation de service public ayant pour objet la gestion et l’exploitation du camping municipal de la commune de Saint-Sever. Le service assure l'accueil des campeurs, la gestion des réservations, l'entretien des installations, l'encaissement des redevances et l'ensemble des prestations nécessaires au bon fonctionnement et entretien du camping. Le Concessionnaire aura notamment pour mission d’assurer : - L’amélioration continue des équipements et services du camping mis à disposition (sanitaires, accueil, aire de jeux et plateau sportif, point de restauration, distributeurs de boissons et snacking en dehors des ouvertures du point de restauration, services extérieurs comme la location de vélos électriques par exemple, des propositions d’activités en lien avec l’Adour et les berges …) - La gestion et l’exploitation du camping, caravaning, avec 70 emplacements minimum avec mobil’homes (dont 2 lodges) avec une montée en gamme des équipements existants. - Le classement aujourd’hui en trois étoiles doit être à minima maintenu voire amélioré en fonction de la proposition du délégataire - la modernisation des installations par la création d’une aire de camping-cars de 10 places minimum et le développement des services associés - la mise en oeuvre de la plantation de 50 arbres pour les emplacements non ombragés aujourd’hui, en coordination avec le service de la commune sur le choix des essences, les techniques de plantation et l’implantation des arbres - la promotion et la commercialisation des équipements sur des sites internet et plateformes de réservations d’hébergements touristiques et réseaux sociaux - l’entretien des ouvrages et bien matériels et immobiliers mis à disposition - l’accueil du public

title: Legal and Strategic Advisory Services Refresh / On-Ramping #01
description: This is a combined synopsis/solicitation and request for proposals (RFP) for commercial products or commercial services in accordance with the procedures of Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) part 12 - Acquisition of Commercial Products and Commercial Services and FAR part 15 - Contracting by Negotiation. Specifically, the Federal Housing Finance Agency (FHFA) is issuing this RFP in accordance with Attachment A, Performance Work Statement (PWS), Section 25, �On-Ramping and Refresh of [Indefinite-Delivery, Indefinite-Quantity] IDIQ Holders,� which states, �the Government retains the unilateral right, at any time during the ordering period of this IDIQ contract, to issue additional solicitations and award new IDIQ contracts for the same or substantially similar scope of work to refresh, expand, or otherwise ensure an adequate pool of qualified contractors.� FHFA issued previous RFP FHF-26-R-0032 for �Legal and Strategic Advisory Services,� which resulted in award of six (6) multiple-award IDIQ contracts: 95314326D0002 (ARNOLD & PORTER KAYE SCHOLER LLP) 95314326D0003 (BAKER & HOSTETLER LLP) 95314326D0004 (COHEN SEGLIAS PALLAS GREENHALL & FURMAN PC) 95314326D0005 (DUANE MORRIS LLP) 95314326D0006 (MAYNARD NEXSEN P.C) 95314326D0007 (MINTZ, LEVIN, COHN, FERRIS, GLOVSKY AND POPEO, P.C.) As a result of this Refresh / On-Ramping RFP, FHFA anticipates awarding multiple (likely no more than three (3)) IDIQ contract(s) with an ordering period from effective date of award to 07/26/2031, with the ability for task order performance to extend beyond that date in accordance with applicable terms and procedures. FHFA reserves the unilateral right to award no new IDIQ contracts under this Refresh / On-Ramping RFP. In the event FHFA awards IDIQ contracts as a result of this Refresh / On-Ramping RFP, the IDIQ contracts awarded will be incorporated into the existing multiple-award IDIQ contract vehicle and be eligible to compete for task orders as of the effective date of the award. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation with offers requested. FHFA has a requirement for law firms to provide legal and strategic advisory services to FHFA, which may include but are not limited to: litigation at the state and federal level; oversight and coordination of legal strategy; advice on policy decision making; regulatory advice with respect to the Regulated Entities, the Office of Finance, and U.S. FinTech LLC; significant experience with the Housing and Economic Recovery Act of 2008; legal advice in the areas of banking law, securities law, financial services regulation law; significant experience with the requirements of the Dodd-Frank Wall Street Reform and Consumer Protection Act, bankruptcy law, real estate law, antitrust law, administrative law, corporate law (including matters involving boards of directors and governance), insurance law, conservatorships and receiverships of financial institutions, insolvency law, artificial intelligence, privacy law (including but not limited to Privacy Act and Freedom of Information Act matters), internal operations, and other areas of law as needed. A significant portion of the work under these contracts is anticipated to be litigation related, both at the trial court and appellate levels. Litigation services may include, but are not limited to, investigations relating to fraud or other matters; multifamily and single-family real estate matters such as foreclosures, receiverships, or lien priority; federal, state, and local actions that may involve fines, fees, or penalties; issues that may arise related to the conservatorships of Fannie Mae or Freddie Mac; and other litigation or legal advice concerning matters related to the Regulated Entities, the Office of Finance, and U.S. FinTech, LLC. For litigation services, the Contractor shall also provide, as directed by FHFA, court reporting, videography, electronic discovery, exhibit preparation, and expert consultants/witnesses, and any other litigation related services as needed, including administrative and operational support services to support the representation of FHFA. In addition to litigation related issues, contractors are sought for non-litigation areas of legal practice to provide legal advice, analysis, and fact-finding, if appropriate, that are related to the areas of expertise described above. Please refer to Attachment A, PWS, for additional information. Questions or other suggested changes must be submitted via email to Steven Novotny, FHFA Contracting Officer, at Steven.Novotny@fhfa.gov by 9:00 a.m. Eastern on September 15, 2026. Offerors must use Attachment E to organize and submit their questions. The Phase I submission is due no later than the date and time identified on the Contract Opportunities webpage. Please refer to the attachments for additional information.

Challenge sponsor: Department of National Defense (DND) Funding mechanism: Contract Opening date: August 24, 2026 Closing date: September 21, 2026, 14:00 Eastern time Challenge Problem statement The CA soldier will face an increasingly complex and dangerous battlespace in the future. A major element of the complexity and danger is the proliferation of multi-spectral sensors and precision weapons that will limit the CA’s ability to move cargo and strike enemy targets at range by using attritable ballistic trajectory weapons without the risk of being targeted and attacked. The CA presently lacks an UGS capable of conducting short-range cargo delivery of light supplies or remote munitions drops. The CA requires an innovative cargo UGS that provides an uncrewed alternative to move combat supplies forward towards the frontline and to deliver munitions independent of predictable ballistic trajectories and large visual signatures. This innovation must be simple, durable, and highly survivable, providing soldiers with an effective capability for future conflicts that integrates seamlessly into operations while minimizing training and maintenance requirements, allowing soldiers to focus on their mission. Desired outcomes and considerations Essential (mandatory) outcomes The proposed solution must: 1. Be composed of a : a. Ground Vehicle: The vehicle containing the onboard electronics, propulsion, and payload. b. Sensor Payload: The equipment required for navigation and to complete a mission, such as cameras or imaging systems. c. Ground Control Station (GCS): The system used by the human operator to control the vehicle and manage missions. Example of GCS components includes without limitation, laptop, tablet, handheld controller, etc. d. Radio: The wireless system that connects the GCS to the UGS to transmit commands and receive telemetry/ data. e. Battery with Charger: A battery for the UGS and a battery charger capable of charging multiple batteries simultaneously. f. Remote antenna: An external antenna placed 100m from the GCS to enhance signal strength, reduce interference, and extend operational range. 2. Operate in a temperature range of -20°C and +40°C. 3. Have a maximum weigh of 410kg in an unladen state. 4. Have a minimum operational radius of 5km (unladen) from the GCS while maintaining user control and live video via Radio Frequency link. 5. Have a minimum operational radius of 10km (unladen) while operating autonomously. 6. Operate at a minimum speed of 15km/hr and a minimum endurance of 4hrs in continuous motion while in an unladen state. 7. Be able to tow a load of 275kg. 8. Be able to carry a load of 140kg onboard the ground vehicle. 9. Be able to carry a tri-wall cargo container measuring 122cm (length) x 102cm (width) x 92cm (height) onboard the ground vehicle. 10. Be capable of navigating paved roads, sand trails, and gravel trails during both day and night at a minimum gradient of 15 degrees (approach and lateral). 11. Have sustained mobility of =7 km/h across while carrying its rated payload across roads, trails, and cross-country terrain. The vehicle must ascend 20% grades, traverse 15% side slopes, negotiate a 250 mm vertical step, and cross a 500 m trench. Additional outcomes The proposed solution should: 1. Be deployable from a stowed state to a mission-ready state in 30 minutes or less. This includes the completion of all pre-mission preparation activities, including but not limited to unstrapping/unloading vehicle, loading/fueling the power system and loading/configuring mission set, resulting in a vehicle that is fully mission-ready at the line of departure. 2. Be appropriately sized such that a minimum of two UGS are stowable for transport on a standard palletized loading system (PLS) deck of 2.44 m x 6.10 m (8 feet wide by 20 feet long). 3. Be capable of operating via fibre-optic cable or other non-electromagnetic (non-EM) communications, enabling operator control from at least 100 m from the vehicle. 4. be powered by electric or hybrid engines; 5. incorporate front automated obstacle avoidance features; 6. emit no more than 5 decibels Sound Pressure Level (dB SPL) of noise in all frequency ranges, measured at a 500m distance from the vehicle; 7. Be recoverable by a North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO)-standard tow hook. 8. Have an aggregated projected production cost of $150,000 CAD or less per system. 9. Have a Ground Control Station (GCS) that: a. Incorporates a simulation capability for Mission Planning. b. Has a minimum remote antenna cable length of 50m. c. Enables UGS navigation via both direct operator control and autonomously using waypoint navigation via the Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS). d. Displays the following information: - Location of vehicle in 6 figure Military Grid Reference System (MGRS); - Orientation of vehicle (pitch/roll/yaw); - Point of aim of camera in 6 figure MGRS; - Real-time full motion video feed; and - Battery life. e. Is capable of interfacing with the Tactical Assault Kit (TAK) battle management system to push uncrewed aircraft system (UAS) Position Location Information (PLI) and target PLI. f. Is able to direct the vehicle to return to a pre-determined location in case of loss of link. 10. Demonstrate capacity in havi

title: COMBINED PRE-SOLICITATION SYNOPSIS AND NOTICE OF INTENT TO AWARD A SOLE-SOURCE CONTRACT: 5-year IDIQ/Enterprise Contract for Everfox Software Licenses, Maintenance and Support Services
description: COMBINED PRE-SOLICITATION SYNOPSIS AND NOTICE OF INTENT TO AWARD A SOLE-SOURCE CONTRACT (COMMERCIAL OFF-THE-SHELF EVERSOFT SOFTWARE) FAR Part 12 This special notice meets posting requirements of RFO FAR 5.1, 6.1, 12.1 and DFARS 206.3. It also serves as market research pursuant to RFO FAR 10. The Government intends to award a 5-year, sole-source, Indefinite Delivery, Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ)/Enterprise Contract (EC) with the first order to be issued prior to the conclusion of Fiscal Year 2026. Anticipated Contract Type: Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP) Intended Sole Source OEM: Everfox (https://www.everfox.com/) Estimated Contract Ceiling: $75M-$90M This notice is not a request for competitive proposals. However, all responsible sources may submit a quotation, which shall be considered by the agency. DESCRIPTION OF REQUIRED SUPPLIES AND SERVICES The Government has an ongoing operational requirement to procure enterprise-level, commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) software licenses, specialized hardware appliances, hardware/software maintenance, and engineering support services provided by Everfox. (or brand-name equivalent solutions satisfying all salient characteristics) The requirement encompasses a 5-year Ordering Period. Specific part numbers, nomenclature, and projected annual quantities across the total ordering period are itemized in the attached spreadsheet ("Attachment 1 - Requirements Listing"). The required supplies and services are categorized across three core areas: A. SOFTWARE LICENSES, SUBSCRIPTIONS, AND MAINTENANCE Cross-Domain Guards: Perpetual and subscription licenses, standard maintenance, and associated filter bundles for Structured Guard (2070 Series), Unstructured Guard (2068 Series), and High-Speed Guard (2071 Series) supporting multi-network data transfer. Centralized Management & Endpoint Access: Control Center Server and Managed Device subscriptions (CCMDS/CCSVS Series) and Trusted Thin Client (TTC) Distribution Console, End User Device (EUD), and Network Resource licenses (10251 Series). Collaboration & Security Plugins: Everfox Information eXchange (DSIXTL1PU), Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) Extended Lifecycle Support (ELS) nodes, and McAfee-integrated Virus Scanning Plug-Ins (2070VSP Series). Form, Fit, and Function: Software must execute native cross-domain security filtering and multi-level desktop access without requiring modification to existing agency security classification boundary policies. B. HARDWARE APPLIANCES AND HARDWARE MAINTENANCE Data Diode Appliances: Fiber-optic hardware-enforced one-way data transfer appliances (FDD10G Series) including annual hardware warranty and associated software maintenance. Cross-Domain Access (CDA) & Verifier Hardware: G2CI Cross Domain Access V2 custom hardware and hardware maintenance (1079H-CDA Series) and High-Speed Verifier turnkey appliances (HSVT Series). Form, Fit, and Function: Hardware units must conform to standard 19-inch rack-mount form factors, interface with existing fiber-optic distribution fabrics, and satisfy DoD physical separation and emissions containment standards. C. SPECIALIZED ENGINEERING AND TECHNICAL SERVICES Direct Tier-3/4 Engineering Support: Dedicated Junior, Mid-level, and Senior Product Engineers (5000/5001/5002-CDA Series) possessing relevant security clearances to provide on-site/remote deployment, complex troubleshooting, and integration. Training and Operational Travel: Basic and advanced CDA system administration training (40003-CDA Series) and associated travel (PS-TRAV-CDA) in support of mission locations. All responsible sources�including OEM-authorized commercial resellers and distributors�may submit a quote for the exact products (or brand-name equivalents) and quantities listed in Attachment 1. If submitting a quote for brand name equivalents, your quote must be supported by a capability statement (3-page limit, 11 pt. font) and a crosswalk of proposed alternatives to the requirements listed herein. Quoted Pricing Submission Requirements: Pricing must be separated by year Each line item must include Part Number, Product Description, PoP, Type, unit pricing and extended pricing Any additional fees Attach the End User License Agreement (EULA)/ End User Service Agreement (EUSA) and include a statement of understanding that the attached addendum (Attachment 2 � Federal SLA Addendum) or one patently similar (and approved by the Contracting Officer after legal review) MUST be signed by the OEM prior to award.

title: Notice of Intent - Sole Source - SOG Assessment
description: Notice of Intent to award a sole source requirement for SOG Assessment Services to Horizon Performance LLC (UEI: K4U8LGLJ2LG1). This proposed contract action is for SOG Assessment Services for which the Government intends to solicit and negotiate with only one source under the authority of RFO FAR 13-106-1(b)(1)(i) � Only One Responsible Source. Horizon Performance has successfully implemented a turnkey solution for the BORTAC Selection and Certification Course holistic personnel assessment system. The system is fully operationally capable and currently supports BORTAC�s assessment requirements. BORTAC now requires annual software licensing, continued maintenance, technical consultation, and additional configuration or expansion of capability as required under the period of performance. Horizon Performance is the only source reasonably available to meet this requirement because Horizon Performance developed and currently maintains the customized assessment platform and associated configurations used for the BORTAC Selection and Certification Course. The existing system includes proprietary software, course-specific configurations, assessment structures, reporting tools, and methodology developed for BORTAC�s operational and training environment. Continued annual licensing, maintenance, updates, and technical consultation require access to Horizon Performance�s proprietary software and configuration environment. Due to the complexity and depth of the assessment system, and the requirement to maintain operational continuity, the provider must be able to: Leverage the existing assessment system currently in use and rapidly integrate BORTAC and BORSTAR values, training concepts, operational concepts, and individual performance attributes within the required period of performance. Provide a holistic personnel assessment system based on sound Industrial/Organizational Psychology-backed science, individual high-performance modeling, and a proven application process. Provide qualified Industrial/Organizational Psychology and subject matter expert consulting applicable to the assessment of individuals as part of an elite organization. Provide a developed Commercial Off-The-Shelf customizable software solution with technical configurations specific to the identified SOG training ecosystems. Maintain, update, and modify the existing proprietary system without disruption to the current BORTAC assessment capability. Integrate BORSTAR requirements into the same assessment framework to ensure compatibility of methodology, data structure, reporting, and longitudinal analysis across SOG programs. A change to another vendor would require development of a new assessment system, recreation of BORTAC-specific configurations, potential re-baselining of assessment data, additional validation and consulting support, and transition activities. These activities would result in duplicative cost and delay and would not meet the Government�s requirement for continuity of the existing assessment capability during the required period of performance. BORSTAR�s initial build must be integrated into the existing SOG assessment framework to maintain consistency of methodology, reporting, data structure, and performance analysis across BORTAC and BORSTAR programs. Horizon Performance is the only vendor with the ability to license, maintain, modify, and expand the existing proprietary system to support both BORTAC sustainment and BORSTAR integration within the required timeframe. Market research did not identify another source with the legal rights or technical ability to license, maintain, modify, or expand the existing Horizon Performance system. Therefore, only Horizon Performance is reasonably available for this requirement under FAR 13.106-1(b)(1). This synopsis is for informational purposes only and is not a request for competitive proposals. Interested parties may identify their interest and capability by responding to this synopsis. The Government will consider all capability information received prior to the closing date. Information received will be considered solely for the purpose of determining whether to conduct a competitive procurement. A determination by the Government not to compete based upon responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government. There is no commitment by the Government to issue any solicitation, make an award, or be responsible for any monies expended by any interested party before award of a contract for the efforts detailed above. Information provided herein in no way binds the Government to solicit for or award a contract. This notice of intent is not a request for quotations. No solicitation will be made available. The point of contact for this action is Max Hempe, Contracting Officer (CO), max.hempe@cbp.dhs.gov. The Government shall not be responsible for costs for any action taken in response to this announcement. Only email questions accepted. No phone calls.

As a critical element of technical capability, the Government will perform a security and supply chain compliance review in accordance with FAR 52.240-91 (Security Prohibitions and Exclusions). Phase 2 (Technical & Past Performance): The Government will initially evaluate only the quotes for technical capability (meeting all requirements in Attachment 1) and past performance. Phase 3 (Award Selection): If one of the three-lowest quotes is determined to represent the best value and is technically acceptable, award will be made to that offeror. If none of the first three quotes are determined to represent the best value to the Government, the evaluation team will evaluate the fourth lowest-priced quote, and so on, in ascending order of price, until a best value awardee is selected. description: MEGA 6 Industry Day & Networking Session Announcement The U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ) formally invites industry partners, government contractors, and DOJ representatives to attend the MEGA 6 Industry Day and Networking Session on Monday, October 26, 2026. MEGA 6 is DOJ�s next major multiple?award contract vehicle for automated litigation support services, following the $1.5B MEGA 5 vehicle. This follow-on acquisition will expand the Department�s ability to procure modern information technology, e-discovery solutions, and professional legal staffing to support complex federal litigation. Artificial intelligence is poised to significantly shape the capabilities anticipated under MEGA 6 and the future of DOJ litigation support. As reflected in ongoing DOJ AI engagement, including procurement and policy discussions held across components AI will increasingly augment legal workflows, accelerate case processing, and improve data-driven decision-making. AI tools offer the potential to automate labor-intensive back?office functions such as document review, classification, privileged material identification, and data extraction. Instead of replacing legal professionals, AI systems act as an �augmenting superpower,� reducing manual burden and enabling attorneys, paralegals, and litigation support professionals to focus on higher-value analytical and advisory work. Agentic AI technologies will help streamline massive evidence ingestion, improve accuracy, and accelerate early case assessment. As MEGA 6 evolves, industry partners should anticipate growing integration of AI-enabled workflows, advanced analytics, automated discovery tools, and new service models that balance efficiency with human expertise. DOJ seeks partners capable of innovating responsibly prioritizing accuracy, security, accountability, and ethical deployment in support of mission-critical legal operations. This event will connect industry partners, DOJ components, and government contractors to share program goals, outline MEGA 6 requirements, and discuss capabilities anticipated in the new vehicle. Attendance is strictly limited to in?person participation only, and each company may register no more than two attendees. Seating is limited to 80 total participants, and early registration is strongly encouraged. Event Details Date: October 26, 2026 Time: 9:00 AM � 11:00 AM (ET) Location: 145 N Street NE, Room 1W.1001, Washington, DC 20002 Format: In-person only (no virtual broadcast) Security & Check-In: � Arrive early for federal facility screening � Bring valid REAL?ID compliant ID or U.S. Passport Networking Session Following the general presentation, DOJ will host a structured networking session enabling contractors to highlight and discuss their organizational capabilities related to MEGA 6. This session will offer one-on-one engagement with DOJ representatives, providing direct feedback on the unique services and innovations industry partners may bring to the litigation support environment. Registration Requirements RSVP required by COB Monday, September 21, 2026 to christina.murray@usdoj.gov using the attached registration form. Registration will close once capacity is reached or at the deadline, whichever occurs first.

description: Supporting eGovernment and Innovation in Public Administration (InnoPA) is a joint project implemented by the German Agency for International Cooperation (GIZ) in Egypt, on behalf of the German Federal Government, and in partnership with the Ministry of Communications and Information Technology (MCIT). The project aims to strengthen the capacities of the public sector and civil society to drive an inclusive and responsive digital transformation in line with European standards. The InnoPA project implements a variety of interventions in the areas of institutional capacity building, innovation promotion, digital inclusion, and policy support. The project adopts the principle of "leave no one behind" to ensure that all segments of society benefit from the digital transformation process and enjoy an effective and responsive public administration. The project has three pillars: 1) Support an inclusive, citizen-centered digital transformation of the public sector, the project aims to bridge the digital divide and increase the uptake of existing digital public services. To this end, collaborations with civil society organizations will be carried out to enhance the digital skills of both citizens and civil servants, alongside additional measures focused on strengthening institutional capacity. 2) Promotes innovative solutions for the inclusive and citizen-oriented digital transformation of the public sector. A key part of this effort is the GovTech Innovation Programme, which accelerates startups and the creation of inclusive technological products that enhance government services and responsiveness to citizens' needs and 3) Provides support for the development of forward-looking digital strategies and legal frameworks in emerging areas such as trust services, artificial intelligence, and data-driven decision-making, in line with EU digitalization standards.

title: Directed Faith Community Reintegration Project – Muslim Initiative
description: Notice of Proposed Procurement (NPP) Directed Faith Community Reintegration Project – Muslim Initiative This requirement is for: The Correctional Service of Canada in the Greater Toronto and Hamilton Areas and the Edmonton area. Trade agreement: This procurement is not subject to any trade agreement. Policy on Reciprocal Procurement: This solicitation is open only to Canadian suppliers. Competitive Procurement Strategy: Compliant bid with the highest combined score of technical merit and price. Set-aside under the Procurement Strategy for Indigenous Business: This procurement is not subject to any set-asides for Indigenous Suppliers. Comprehensive Land Claim Agreement: This procurement is not subject to a Comprehensive Land Claims Agreement. Security Requirements: This contract includes security requirements. Nature of Requirements: The following is a summary of the statement of work for this requirement. The Correctional Service Canada has a requirement to provide Directed Faith Community Reintegration services in the Greater Toronto and Hamilton Areas and the Edmonton area. Faith Community Reintegration Projects (FCRPs) support successful offender reintegration following their release from CSC institutions. Directed Faith Community Reintegration Projects (DFCRPs) are a specialized extension of FCRPs that align with CSC’s public safety mandate by supporting the reintegration of offenders from traditionally underserved faith communities. DFCRPs link offender reintegration goals to the mandates of organizations from traditionally underserved faith communities that are prepared to offer religious and spiritual services to offenders after release. DFCRPs support offender reintegration plans and program goals, by providing a range of services and activities that facilitate the transition and reintegration of individuals back into the community. These projects are designed to meet the unique religious and spiritual needs of specific groups, helping ensure that everyone has access to meaningful support on their reintegration journey. Communities of faith typically offer many diverse, faith-based, pro-social activities to the public that foster a sense of belonging while contributing to spiritual and religious growth. Offender involvement in these activities offers a direct means of addressing and mitigating risk factors linked to reoffending. DFCRPs facilitate and support the unique contribution of faith communities toward a holistic approach to safe and restorative reintegration practices. Objectives: To support successful offender reintegration following release from CSC institutions by: • Developing faith community capacity to engage with offenders; • Building bridges between offenders and their religious and spiritual community groups; • Liaising with parole and justice organizations, and faith communities; • Supporting offender reintegration plans and program goals; and • Assisting offenders to become contributing members of society. CSC may award up to two (2) contracts as a result of this Request for Proposal (RFP), one contract per STREAM. Stream 1 – Greater Toronto and Hamilton Areas Stream 2 – Edmonton Area Bidders may submit a proposal for one or both STREAMS. However, Bidders submitting a bid for both STREAMS must be able to provide sufficient services and resources, to meet CSC’s requirements for all the location(s) listed within the identified stream. Deliverables: The Contractor must submit the following to the Project Authority: 1. a copy of the disengagement model being used no later than six (6) months after contract award; 2. a copy of the monthly quantitative indicator reports and invoices no later than thirty (30) days after the end of the month during which the Contractor delivered the services; 3. a copy of the quarterly qualitative reports no later than thirty (30) days after the end of each quarterly reporting period. description: This Request for Quote (RFQ) is for the contractor to preform Life Safety and Canal Entrance Sign Installation at McAlpine Locks and Dam, in accordance with the attached Scope of Work (SOW). The contractors work and responsibility shall include all planning, programming, administration, management, supervision, communications, and inspection necessary to ensure that all work is conducted in accordance with the contract requirements and all applicable Federal, State and Local laws and regulations.
